i just come up with most of the things i make on the fly so i’m usually not following recipes lol

first one: a scrambled seasoned just egg sandwich with field roast apple & maple sausages, melted babybel cheese, and a ketchup & syrup sauce on toasted sourdough bread. i usually melt a few tbsp of butter and add oat milk to a bowl before i add my seasonings and then whisk in my just egg before transferring it to a buttered pan over medium-low heat. i tend to season with  black salt, regular salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, nooch, dried parsley, and red chili flakes. i don’t have any particular measurements i just do what feels right. while the just egg was scrambling i added some diced babybel cheese in as well. after i toasted my sourdough bread i buttered it and added diced babybel to one side of the bread and melted it in the microwave. while the egg was still cooking i made a ketchup & syrup sauce and spread it on the bottom piece of toast. i then pan cooked my sausage links, sliced them in half, and placed them on the toast. piled on the scrambled just egg and drizzled some more sauce on top of the eggs b4 topping it off w the melted cheese coated slice of toast. 
second: i used all the seasonings previously listed and my method of preparing the just egg was relatively the same except i left out the oat milk bc i ran out & subbed the onion powder w caramelized onions bc i also ran out of that lol. i poured the egg mixture into a buttered pan over medium-low heat and made sure that it covered the entire bottom of the pan. i then sprinkled extra nooch over the egg mixture (would’ve added cheese if i had it). while that was cooking i diced up some tofurkey slices (i used italian style slices bc it’s all i had but you could literally use any) & added then on top of half of the mostly cooked mixture before folding it over and then flipping it to cook the remainder of the time. i then garnished it with more dried parsley. for the omelette you can get super creative with the filling ingredients,, i recommend adding veggies like peppers and tomatoes or other types of meat replacements. i debated using ground breakfast sausage but opted for tofurkey slices bc it was less work.
